decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Add / edit / delete bookmarks (URL, ...)' and API 'POST /api/bookmarks'; round 1 client: 'I can save ... bookmarks.' Presented save-by-URL conforms.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Saving a bookmark by URL matches REF-BM-01; conforming presented decision.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'title defaults to the URL' and 'Favicons load from Google's favicon service, so they need outbound internet to display'; no auto-collection of title/description/preview image presented. Round 1 client: bare approval, no mention of metadata.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Reference REF-BM-02 requires auto-collecting title, description, favicon, and preview image on save; maker only derives a favicon via an external service and defaults title to the URL — no auto title/description/preview. Divergence established independently of response; client's bare 'happy with the app' neither expresses nor corrects the difference.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker lists editable fields as 'URL, title, description, tags' only; no note field and no markdown note rendering. Round 1 client: 'I can ... edit ... bookmarks' (bare approval).
decisions.note: Prototype review. REF-BM-04 includes editing a note and REF-BM-23 requires a markdown note rendered on view; neither is present in the presented edit fields. Divergence established; approval does not surface or accept the difference.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Add / edit / delete bookmarks' and API 'DELETE /api/bookmarks/:id'; round 1 client: '... and remove bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Delete conforms to REF-BM-05; conforming presented decision.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Comma-separated tags with a sidebar tag cloud + counts'; round 1 client: 'I can ... organize ... bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Assigning one or more tags conforms to REF-BM-09; conforming presented decision.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: tags entered as 'Comma-separated tags'; no autocomplete of existing tags on entry is presented. Round 1 client: bare approval.
decisions.note: Prototype review. REF-BM-10 requires offering existing tags as autocomplete on tag entry; the presented comma-separated free-text entry does not. Divergence established independently; not surfaced or accepted by the client.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'click a tag to filter' and API '?tag=' filter; round 1 client: 'organize, find'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Filtering to a single selected tag conforms to REF-BM-11; conforming presented decision.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Live search across title, URL, description, and tags'; round 1 client: 'I can ... find ... bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Basic full-text search over title/description/url is present (REF-BM-12), treated as conforming; case-insensitivity (REF-BM-13) not contradicted. Advanced operators (REF-BM-14/15/16) were not presented as decisions and cannot be established as divergent from the record, so not counted here.
